attrs.evidence: GPT-5.6's observation, and this loop supplies the data for it. Rounds 3, 4.1 and 5 each closed ZERO table cells; all three added claim-discipline machinery. Under a cells-closed measurand the loop has been stalled for three rounds; under a claims-settled measurand it has not. Both measurands are now written down in mosaic/objectives.json and they are left DISAGREEING, because picking the flattering one is the failure this record exists to name. What is NOT established is any obligation to promote on a cadence: the honest statement is that safe rejection, deadlock, evaluator starvation, permanently unresolved assumptions and productive refusal are five different states and this loop currently cannot tell them apart.
attrs.prior_art: The safety/liveness decomposition (Alpern & Schneider 1985) is the formal neighbourhood; GPT-5.6 supplied the application to a self-improving factory.
attrs.review_focus: Three rounds of zero cells closed is either the discipline paying for itself before the next theorem, or a loop that has found it easier to improve its own bookkeeping than to answer a hard question. Nothing in the artifact distinguishes those, and this record does not either.
attrs.statement: Safety and progress need separate semantics: a factory that refuses every change satisfies every preservation invariant, so 'no invariant was broken' cannot be the definition of a successful round.
